start.text: Whose perspective are you reflecting on?

select_context.text: What is the situation or moment you're focusing on?

paw_pain.text: PAIN – What emotional pain or unmet need was present in that moment?

paw_ambition.text: AMBITION – What did the person want to become or achieve at that time?

paw_wants.text: WANTS – What was the person hoping for in the moment?

pod_perspective.text: PERSPECTIVE – What assumptions did this person make about the situation or others?

options.label: They assumed they had to act alone

pod_other_views.text: OTHER VIEWS – What are some alternative ways to interpret the situation?

options.label: Maybe others were doing their best
Maybe I had more support than I thought

pod_dialogue.text: What kind of conversation would support healing or understanding?

options.label: I see why you felt that way
You were doing your best with what you knew
You had hopes that really mattered
That made sense given what you were going through
You’ve survived a lot. You’re still here. That means something.
It’s okay to start again—you're not stuck.
Things can change even if they’ve been hard for a long time.
You deserve the chance to heal and grow.
What can we learn from this together?
Let’s be honest and kind moving forward.
We all had different views—how do we realign?
How can we better support each other next time?

end.text: Thank you for exploring this perspective. Your insight has been saved as a lantern bead.
